purpose: Verify FIPS203 key-generation provenance, then exploratory parameter-family transfer; no cryptanalytic claim.
acvp_cases: all 25 cases in each of the three FIPS203 key-generation parameter groups
reference_policy: Public CBD-support exhaustive search supplies a feasible bound only to the evaluation reference; QAOA still starts at public Babai. No failures or uncovered cases discarded.
evaluation_policy: Exploratory sensitivity, not a held-out validation or training cohort. Secret/optimum checks are evaluation only. Report any sampled planted-secret hit separately from the secret returned by the cost-minimizing decoder.
